description:
Navigate to the Floreant POS Back Office and update the receipt footer message. 

Goal: Change the text that appears at the bottom of printed receipts to display the Wi-Fi information.

Steps:
1. Log in to Back Office using PIN: 1111
2. Go to Configuration -> Print/Receipt tab
3. Set the 'Footer Message' to exactly: "Wi-Fi: DinerGuest / Pass: pancakes24"
4. Save the configuration.
